evidence_quotes.quote: Community-Managed Water Supply Systems in Rural Uganda: The Role of Participation and Capacity Development
Received: 8 August 2018; Accepted: 13 September 2018; Published: 18 September 2018
This study sought to evaluate community participation and capacity development in WUCs in relation to community-managed water supply systems.
